text:
Open-ear earbuds for running come down to a few picks. I could only read the SoundGuys roundup. Runner's World and WIRED wouldn't load, so I didn't use them. Prices below are from SoundGuys and change often.

**My picks**

- **Best value: Soundcore AeroFit 2, about $80 on Amazon (list $99.99).** It has an IP55 rating for sweat and four adjustable ear-hook positions for a secure fit. It also has multipoint pairing and 23 EQ presets. The touch controls can be overly sensitive. One owner reported about 6 hours of battery against the claimed 10.
- **Best for long runs: Shokz OpenFit 2, $179.95.** SoundGuys lists about 11 hours of battery and physical buttons that work with gloves. That makes it a good fit for marathon training.
- **Lightest clip-on: HUAWEI FreeClip 2, $199.99.** It has an IP57 rating and is light enough that you forget you're wearing it. It also has more bass than you'd expect from a clip-on. It's pricey, and the clip-on fit varies from person to person.
- **Best mid-price all-rounder: Nothing Ear (Open), about $99 (list $149).** It has an IP54 rating, strong bass for an open design, a customizable EQ and long battery life.
- **Most secure fit among the earbud-style picks: Sony LinkBuds Open, about $158 (list $230).** It has a stabilizing fin and about 9.5 hours of battery. Sony rates it IPX4-equivalent.

**Other options**
- **Shokz OpenRun Pro 2** is the bone-conduction choice. It sits on top of your ears instead of in them, and the Bose-vs-Shokz comparison in your results covers it. I couldn't read a review of it, so I can't vouch for details.
- **Bose Ultra Open Earbuds**, $299, are a clip-on option. SoundGuys lists them as a notable mention, but they're expensive.

**My advice:** Start with the AeroFit 2 unless you run more than 2 hours at a time. If you do, get the OpenFit 2. Open-ear fit is personal, so buy somewhere with easy returns.

**Links**
- [SoundGuys: best open-ear headphones and earbuds](https://www.soundguys.com/best-open-ear-headphones-and-earbuds-115102/). It has retail links for each pick.
- One search result, from Dealectric, claims a code (AFSC20) takes the AeroFit 2 from $129.99 to $104 at Soundcore's store. That price differs from SoundGuys' $79.99 Amazon price. I didn't verify it, so compare prices before using it: [Dealectric listing](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-aerofit-2).
